day_shape: 51 items: Iran's SNSC chief Rezaei tells Al Jazeera Tehran has passed conditions via Qatari and Pakistani mediators to end war with US, CENTCOM marks 2,000+ Hormuz escorts, IDF strikes Hezbollah after 2 soldiers wounded in south Lebanon bomb, Iran executes alleged Mossad informant.

threads.label: Iran signals conditional talks via mediators
threads.summary: SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei told Al Jazeera Iran has conveyed conditions to Qatari and Pakistani mediators to end the war with the US, listing an end to hostilities on all fronts, unfreezing of assets and lifting the maritime blockade. Rezaei said Iran retains the option to withdraw from the NPT depending on Washington's behaviour but has not changed its nuclear doctrine; Pakistani and Iranian foreign ministers agreed to meet in New York.

threads.label: CENTCOM Hormuz escort tally and Iranian rebuttal
threads.summary: US CENTCOM said it has escorted more than 2,000 commercial ships through the Strait of Hormuz, posting a commander's update. Iranian armed forces spokesman Shakarchian called the CENTCOM commander's claims about tanker escorts and one billion barrels of oil moved over two months a 'failed psychological operation'.

threads.label: IDF strikes Hezbollah after south Lebanon bombing
threads.summary: The IDF said two soldiers were lightly wounded when their engineering vehicle hit a Hezbollah roadside bomb inside the south Lebanon buffer zone. In response the military struck Hezbollah observation posts and infrastructure in several areas of southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Yemen–Saudi exchange of strikes and claims
threads.summary: IRIB cited Yemen's armed forces claiming two operations targeting sites in Riyadh and Aramco installations in Yanbu, while Ansarullah warned Saudi Arabia of 'larger attacks' to come. Yemen's Sanaa-based Foreign Ministry accused Saudi Arabia of causing civilian casualties through interception operations over populated areas and called on the international community to hold Riyadh accountable.

threads.label: Iran execution and Gaza strike reports
threads.summary: Iran executed a man it accused of passing information on missile sites in Isfahan to Israel's Mossad, the judiciary said, one of a series of espionage executions tied to the 12-day war. Palestinian media reported two dead and several injured in an Israeli strike on a vehicle in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan, and the Jerusalem Post reported the son of the Hamas-run Gaza Health Ministry director-general was killed.

events.summary_en: Pezeshkian outlined BRICS achievements for the heads of state. Masoud Pezeshkian presented a report of his visit to India and the achievements of Iran's participation in the eighteenth summit of BRICS leaders. The meeting emphasised elucidating the objectives and outcomes of this visit, including strengthening multilateralism, developing economic and trade cooperation, and countering unilateralism. The heads of state subsequently agreed, emphasising the need for coordination and synergy among the branches of government, that ensuring essential goods and improving the livelihood of the people, supporting production, removing production obstacles, and facilitating the attraction of productive investment should be prioritised in the general policies of the system.

events.summary_en: Yemen: It is the Saudis who target civilians. Yemen's Foreign Ministry announced that the civilian casualties which the Saudi Al Saud government claims in its reports are the result of interception of this regime's air defence systems. Yemen's Foreign Ministry stated that the Saudi government insists on carrying out interception operations over densely populated areas in order to cause the maximum number of casualties. According to this statement, 'Yemen's armed forces have proven over the past 12 years that they do not target civilians or residential areas, but rather target military bases and also oil facilities that finance this regime's criminal military operations.'

events.title_en: Tactical nuclear weapons; a devilish but ineffective tool in the Ukraine war. Russia expected to quickly win the Ukraine war...
events.summary_en: Tactical nuclear weapons; a devilish but ineffective tool in the Ukraine war. Russia expected to quickly win the Ukraine war, but became embroiled in difficulties due to Ukraine's resistance. Now some Russian military experts, trampling humanitarian norms, have proposed the use of tactical nuclear weapons and insist that Ukraine's defence line cannot be destroyed except through their use. For Russia, the Russia-Ukraine war has become deadlocked and from a strategic perspective has failed to achieve favourable results for Moscow; Russia is using various and diverse weapons and its military is advancing slowly, but Moscow had much higher expectations from this war.

events.title: Two IDF soldiers were lightly injured by a Hezbollah explosive device in southern Lebanon this morning, the military says, prompting strikes on the terror group's sites. The IDF says an engineering vehicle was hit by a roadside bomb planted by Hezbollah inside the military's south Lebanon buffer zone. Two soldiers were injured in the blast and taken to a hospital in good condition, the military says, adding that their families were notified. In response to the blast, the IDF says that it struck several Hezbollah infrastructure sites in southern Lebanon, including surveillance posts and sites used by the terror group to advance attacks.
